newsitem.title: USA: John Kennedy Jr's wife pregnant.
newsitem.headline: John Kennedy Jr's wife pregnant.

text.p: John F. Kennedy Jr. and his wife Carolyn Bessette Kennedy are expecting their first child, newspapers reported on Wednesday.
The Daily News and The New York Post quoted unnamed sources close to the couple as saying Carolyn Bessette Kennedy was pregnant.
"Sources report that the couple concentrated on the project during their recent getaway in Milan," Daily News columnists George Rush and Joanna Molloy wrote.
Carolyn Bessette and Kennedy, son of assassinated President John F. Kennedy and once dubbed by People magazine "the sexiest man alive," were married in September 1996.
